name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Income support scheme for eligible farmer families providing ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year (₹2,000 per installment, 3 installments) directly to bank account.
eligibility: Eligible landholding farmer families, subject to scheme conditions.
deadline: Ongoing — apply anytime

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: Health assurance scheme providing ₹5 lakh per family per year for hospitalisation.
benefits: ₹5 lakh health cover per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation.
eligibility: Families identified under applicable government eligibility criteria (SECC database).
deadline: Ongoing — check eligibility anytime

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
description: Housing assistance scheme providing financial support to construct or buy a pucca house.
benefits: Subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh for EWS/LIG; construction assistance for rural households.
eligibility: Eligible EWS, LIG, or other beneficiary categories under the applicable PMAY component.
deadline: Ongoing — apply at nearest CSC or bank

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
description: Credit support scheme for micro enterprises and small businesses.
benefits: Collateral-free loans: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001–₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5–₹10 lakh).
eligibility: Eligible non-corporate small business owners and entrepreneurs.
deadline: Ongoing — apply at any bank or NBFC

name: PM Vishwakarma
description: Support programme for traditional artisans and craftspeople covering skill training, toolkit, and credit.
benefits: ₹15,000 toolkit incentive; skill training stipend ₹500/day; collateral-free credit up to ₹3 lakh.
eligibility: Eligible artisans engaged in notified traditional trades.
deadline: Ongoing — registration at Common Service Centres

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Small-savings scheme for a girl child with tax benefits.
benefits: High interest rate (currently ~8.2% p.a.) with tax exemption under Section 80C; maturity at 21 years.
eligibility: Account may be opened for an eligible girl child below 10 years of age.
deadline: Ongoing — open account at post office or bank

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Pension scheme for eligible citizens, especially workers in the unorganised sector.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 after age 60 based on contribution.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18–40 with a savings bank account.
deadline: Ongoing — enrol via bank or net banking

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
description: Industry-relevant skill training, certification, upskilling, and reskilling programme.
benefits: Free short-term skill training; certification; placement assistance; monetary reward on certification.
eligibility: Eligible Indian youth seeking approved skill training.
deadline: Ongoing — check skill centres near you

name: Central Sector Scholarship Scheme
description: Scholarship support for eligible students pursuing higher education.
benefits: ₹10,000/year for undergraduate students; ₹20,000/year for postgraduate students.
eligibility: Students who scored above 80th percentile in 10+2; family income below ₹8 lakh per year.
deadline: Annual — applications typically open in August–September

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
description: Credit-linked subsidy support for setting up eligible micro-enterprises.
benefits: 25–35% subsidy on project cost for eligible beneficiaries; project cost up to ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) / ₹20 lakh (service).
eligibility: Individuals aged 18+ with at least Class VIII education for projects above ₹10 lakh.
deadline: Ongoing — apply through KVIC/KVIB or banks

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
description: Provides demand-driven wage employment to rural households.
benefits: 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per year; minimum wages paid; social security.
eligibility: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work.
deadline: Ongoing — register at Gram Panchayat

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
description: Provides LPG connection support to eligible households.
benefits: Free LPG connection with a deposit waiver; first refill and hotplate at subsidised cost.
eligibility: Eligible adult women from BPL or notified qualifying households.
deadline: Ongoing — apply at LPG distributor or online

name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
description: Supports installation of rooftop solar systems for eligible households.
benefits: Up to 300 units free electricity per month; subsidy up to ₹78,000 for 3 kW system.
eligibility: Eligible residential electricity consumers with suitable rooftop space.
deadline: Ongoing — apply on official portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Crop insurance scheme that helps protect farmers against specified crop losses.
benefits: Insurance cover for crop losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases; premium as low as 1.5–5%.
eligibility: Eligible farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
deadline: Seasonal — Rabi/Kharif season deadlines apply; check with bank/CSC

name: Kisan Credit Card Scheme
description: Provides timely short-term credit support for agricultural and allied activities.
benefits: Flexible credit up to ₹3 lakh at subsidised interest (4% after subvention); crop insurance coverage.
eligibility: Eligible farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and allied-sector applicants.
deadline: Ongoing — apply at nearest bank branch

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides soil nutrient information and fertilizer-use recommendations to farmers.
benefits: Free soil testing; personalised fertilizer recommendations to increase crop productivity.
eligibility: Farmers with agricultural land or cultivation activity.
deadline: Ongoing — contact nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra

name: PM KUSUM
description: Supports solar pumps and solarisation solutions for eligible agricultural users.
benefits: Subsidy of 30–60% on solar pump installation; reduces irrigation costs significantly.
eligibility: Eligible farmers and agricultural consumers, subject to state implementation rules.
deadline: Ongoing — apply via state DISCOM or agriculture department

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
description: Maternity benefit programme for eligible pregnant women and lactating mothers.
benefits: ₹5,000 in three instalments for first live birth; additional benefit for second girl child birth.
eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers meeting scheme eligibility conditions.
deadline: Ongoing — register at Anganwadi Centre or health facility

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: Renewable life-insurance cover for eligible bank or post-office account holders.
benefits: ₹2 lakh life insurance cover at just ₹436/year premium.
eligibility: Bank/post office account holders aged 18–50 years.
deadline: Ongoing — enrol via bank or net banking annually

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: Renewable accidental-death and disability insurance cover.
benefits: ₹2 lakh for accidental death/total disability; ₹1 lakh for partial disability; premium only ₹20/year.
eligibility: Bank/post-office account holders aged 18–70 years.
deadline: Ongoing — enrol via bank or net banking annually

name: PM SVANidhi
description: Provides working-capital support for eligible street vendors.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000 → ₹20,000 → ₹50,000 on timely repayment.
eligibility: Eligible street vendors identified under applicable scheme rules.
deadline: Ongoing — apply via PM SVANidhi portal or nearest bank

name: Stand-Up India
description: Facilitates bank loans for eligible women and SC/ST entrepreneurs.
benefits: Loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for greenfield enterprises; 7-year repayment period.
eligibility: Women or SC/ST entrepreneurs setting up a new (greenfield) enterprise in manufacturing, services, or trading.
deadline: Ongoing — apply through bank branches or standupmitra.in

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme
description: Promotes apprenticeship training and workplace learning opportunities.
benefits: Monthly stipend reimbursement to establishments; candidates earn while learning on the job.
eligibility: Eligible candidates and establishments under apprenticeship rules; age 14+.
deadline: Ongoing — register at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in

name: Jan Shikshan Sansthan Scheme
description: Provides non-formal vocational training, especially for disadvantaged groups.
benefits: Free vocational skill training; certificate by NCVT; livelihood improvement support.
eligibility: Youth and adults aged 15–45; priority for women, SC/ST, minorities, and rural areas.
deadline: Ongoing — contact nearest JSS centre

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
description: Skill training and placement support for rural youth from poor households.
benefits: Free residential training; placement guarantee; post-placement support; foreign placement for select trades.
eligibility: Rural youth aged 15–35 from poor households; up to 45 for SC/ST/PWD/women.
documents: Ration Card or Rural Household Proof
deadline: Ongoing — contact DDU-GKY Project Implementing Agency

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana National Rural Livelihoods Mission
description: Supports rural livelihoods through self-help groups, financial inclusion, and enterprise development.
benefits: Revolving fund for SHGs; Community Investment Fund; bank linkage support; livelihood training.
eligibility: Rural households, particularly women members of self-help groups.
deadline: Ongoing — contact Block Mission Management Unit

name: National Social Assistance Programme
description: Provides social assistance support through pension and family-benefit components.
benefits: Monthly pension ₹200–₹500 for elderly/widows/disabled; ₹20,000 lump sum on BPL death.
eligibility: BPL elderly (60+), widows (40–79), persons with disabilities (18–79), or bereaved families.
deadline: Ongoing — apply at Gram Panchayat or Urban Local Body

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
description: Promotes access to basic banking services and financial inclusion.
benefits: Zero-balance bank account; RuPay debit card; ₹2 lakh accident insurance; ₹30,000 life cover.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen without access to a bank account; no minimum balance required.
deadline: Ongoing — open account at any bank branch or BCA

name: PM YASASVI Scholarship Scheme
description: Scholarship support for eligible students from OBC, EBC, DNT, and other specified categories.
benefits: ₹75,000/year for Class 9–10 students; ₹1,25,000/year for Class 11–12 students.
eligibility: Students from OBC/EBC/DNT categories; family income below ₹2.5 lakh; Class 9 or 11.
deadline: Annual — NTA releases notification; typically August–September

name: National Career Service
description: Digital career platform offering job search, career counselling, job fairs, and skill information.
benefits: Free job matching; career counselling; access to government job vacancies; skill gap information.
eligibility: Job seekers, students, employers, and career-service users; free registration for all.
deadline: Ongoing — register at NCS portal
